channel.title: Vietnamese Coffee on Barista At Home
channel.description: Recent content in Vietnamese Coffee on Barista At Home

item.title: Bạc Xỉu: Vietnamese White Coffee with Condensed Milk (Recipe & Guide)
item.description: How to make Bạc Xỉu — Saigon's classic Vietnamese white coffee. A milkier, sweeter version of cà phê sữa with extra condensed milk and fresh milk over phin-brewed robusta. Full recipe, hot and iced versions, and how it differs from Cà Phê Sữa Đá.

item.title: Vietnamese Coconut Coffee (Cà Phê Dừa): Recipe, Hot & Iced Versions, and the Hanoi Origin Story
item.description: How to make Vietnamese coconut coffee (cà phê dừa) — the iced phin-brewed coffee topped with a sweet, frosty coconut slushy made famous by Cộng Cà Phê in Hanoi. Full recipe, hot version, calorie and caffeine breakdown, and how it differs from a coconut latte.

item.title: Vietnamese Salt Coffee (Cà Phê Muối): Hue's Salted Coffee Recipe
item.description: How to make authentic Vietnamese salt coffee — Cà Phê Muối — from Hue. Salted whipped milk foam over robusta phin coffee. Recipe, why salt makes coffee taste smoother, hot vs iced versions, and how it differs from Italian salted coffee.

item.title: Phin Coffee: The Complete Vietnamese Drip Filter Guide (Equipment, Technique & Brewing)
item.description: How to brew Vietnamese phin coffee at home: how the phin filter works, sizing chart, best phin brands, exact ratios for hot and iced, grind size, troubleshooting, and how it compares to French press, pour over, and espresso.

item.title: Vietnamese Egg Coffee (Cà Phê Trứng): Recipe, History, and How to Make It at Home
item.description: Vietnamese egg coffee (cà phê trứng) is a Hanoi specialty made with whipped egg yolk, sweetened condensed milk, and strong coffee. Learn how to make it safely at home.

item.title: Vietnamese Coffee: The Complete Guide (Phin, Condensed Milk, and All Styles)
item.description: Vietnamese coffee uses robusta beans, a phin filter, and sweetened condensed milk to create an intensely strong, sweet cup. Here's everything: the phin, hot and iced methods, egg coffee, and more.
